exposure: COVID-19 infection during different pregnancy stages
outcome: Incidence of small for gestational age
cohort: The study included 283 pregnant women from China who were infected with COVID-19, divided into five groups based on the stage of pregnancy at infection.
finding: No adverse maternal or infant outcomes were observed at any stage of maternal SARS-CoV-2 infection, and antibodies in umbilical cord blood and breast milk provided passive immunity to newborns for 1-3 months.
